candidates.lead_note: BoiseDev (Aug 12, 2026) and Idaho Statesman (Aug 19, 2026): the Garden Valley German restaurant and biergarten is opening its second location at 855 W Broad St, Boise (former Bonefish, Hawkins HQ building). The remodel is underway and a podcast mentions a late November target. Website domain not confirmed (Facebook/Instagram only).

Its Paylocity board shows a Member Advisor role at the Idaho Center Branch (6034 Birch Lane, Nampa) among 5 openings, some in Twin Falls and Idaho Falls. Idaho Falls based, with several Boise area branches. It may have only 1 local role.

Toyota store at 15933 N Idaho Center Blvd, Nampa. Careers page loaded Sep 23, 2026 invites applicants for new and pre owned sales consultants, service technicians and service valets/porters. Indeed also shows Nampa Lot Porter postings, and uniforms are listed as a benefit.

Competitive programming page (dated May 30, 2026 in snippet) lists the 2026 to 2027 coaching staff for Thorns girls and Timbers boys. About 400 players a year, ECNL girls, summer camps and tryouts. Based in Meridian.

Nampa Chamber posted a ribbon cutting on Sep 29, 2026 for The Logan Luxury Living, a new apartment community at 2409 Sundance Rd, Nampa. The property management operator still needs to be identified and would be the buyer.

Boise's only roller rink, at 4712 W State St. Recurring dated public sessions and themed nights (Sep 7, 2026 session; Aug 22 themed night on Instagram) and weekly lesson programs suggest a steady need for staff and event apparel.
